scope: Desktop synthetic native-ABI touch source only. Inspect existing callback submission timestamps within previously qualified registered-game-RAF wait intervals; no new browser work or production change. Activity proves timer/native-input execution at those instants, not uninterrupted CPU availability or physical touch latency. Absence is informative only with due input, not a main-thread blocking proof. No cross-Page clock alignment.

sourceSummary.clockIndependence: setTimeout absolute deadlines; never scheduled from game frame, capture, frontier or transport progress.
